semiconductor_relevance: High — LiVe Optronics specializes in advanced laser chips for optical communication and precision sensing, which are critical components in semiconductor applications.
summary: LiVe Optronics Company Limited is a Taipei-based company focused on designing advanced laser chips for optical communication and precision sensing applications. Their product offerings include high-speed VCSEL arrays and high-power DFB lasers, which are essential for AI-driven data centers and long-reach optical communication.
capabilities: 1310 / 1550 nm DFB lasers for silicon-photonics integration

regional_presence.Taiwan: LiVe Optronics leverages Taiwan's mature compound-semiconductor supply chain for high-quality volume manufacturing.
